propositions: conftest.py exceeds the 800 LOC hard cap at 932 lines and requires refactoring to comply with AGENTS.md size targets
extracting the J11 store-copy/DC-client fixture cluster (dc_transport, dc_store_copy_repo, bound_dc_issue) to _dc_fixtures.py reduces conftest to ~758 LOC while preserving the monkeypatch surface
unit tests that load conftest by path and rebind _request and _random_project_key must remain in conftest to prevent silent un-stubbing of network calls in moved functions
moved fixtures must be re-exported into conftest's namespace so pytest continues collecting them as conftest attributes without changing the fixture discovery mechanism
regression tests must verify the by-path-loaded conftest still exposes the required fixture surface and that all monkeypatched symbols remain defined in conftest
